meters.notMeasuredTip: Counting used addresses needs Docker Engine 29 or newer on the manager.

estimated.daemon: These numbers are estimated from the address pools the daemon reports and the bridge subnets Coaming can see.
estimated.defaults: These numbers are estimated. The daemon doesn't set its own address pools, so Coaming counts against Docker's default pools and the bridge subnets it can see.
estimated.entered: These numbers are estimated from the pools you entered in this environment's settings and the bridge subnets Coaming can see.

estimatedTip.daemon: Based on the address pools the daemon reports and the bridge subnets Coaming can see.
estimatedTip.defaults: The daemon sets no pools of its own, so Coaming assumes Docker's documented defaults and counts the bridge subnets it can see.
estimatedTip.entered: Based on the pools you entered in this environment's settings and the bridge subnets Coaming can see.

orphans.title: Orphaned and unused networks
orphans.caption: Coaming lists a network here when nothing has used it for 24 hours. It looks at every service, every task and every node before it decides.

empty.title: No orphaned or unused networks
empty.body: Coaming lists a network here when nothing has used it for 24 hours.

orphaned.label: Orphaned
orphaned.name: Orphaned ({{count, number}})
orphaned.caption: The stack that created these no longer exists, and nothing uses them.

unused.label: Unused
unused.name: Unused ({{count, number}})
unused.caption: No stack created these, and nothing uses them. This is for your information, not a problem.

cantTell.label: Can't tell yet
cantTell.name: Can't tell yet ({{count, number}})
cantTell.caption: Waiting for {{nodes}} to report.
cantTell.captionManager: Waiting for a manager to report.
cantTell.captionOther: Waiting for Coaming to finish reading the environment.

idle.seen: The last time Coaming saw this network in use. Coaming waits 24 hours after that, or after the network was created, before it lists it.
idle.created: Coaming hasn't seen this network in use. This is when it was created.

orphans.waiting: Waiting for {{nodes}} to report. Coaming won't remove a network until every node has answered.
orphans.waitingUnknown: Coaming can't be sure yet. Coaming won't remove a network until every node has answered.
orphans.keepDone_one: Keeping {{name}}. Coaming won't list it again.

delete.title: Delete “{{name}}”?
delete.body: Nothing has used it since {{time}}. Coaming checks again just before it deletes the network, and keeps it if something started using it. The network's details are saved in the audit log first.
delete.bodyBulk: Coaming checks each one again just before it deletes it, and keeps any that something started using. The details of each network are saved in the audit log first.
delete.summary: Deleted {{deleted, number}}, kept {{kept, number}}, {{failed, number}} failed

kept.inUseAgain: {{name}} is in use again, so Coaming kept it.
kept.notOrphaned: {{name}} is no longer orphaned, so Coaming kept it.
kept.nodeMissing: Couldn't confirm {{name}} is unused: {{node}} isn't reporting. Coaming kept it.

refused.inspectTooLarge: Coaming didn't delete {{name}}: its details are over 64 KB, too large to save in the audit log first.
refused.builtin: {{name}} is one of Docker's own networks, so Coaming can't delete it.
refused.keepBuiltin: {{name}} is one of Docker's own networks, which Coaming never lists, so there is nothing to keep.
refused.keepNode: More than one node has a network called {{name}}. Keep it from its row in the list.

kept.caption: Coaming never lists these as orphaned or unused, and the janitor leaves them alone.
kept.labelReason: Kept by the coaming.keep label on the network. Remove the label to stop keeping it.
kept.byLabel: {{name}} is kept by a label on the network. Remove the label to stop keeping it.
